question: Can a pre-existing symbolic link under root/objects/<sha-prefix>/ cause import_url to write captured bytes outside the configured storage root?
test_setup: A temporary authorized root and separate outside temp directory; synthetic JSON bytes; pre-create objects/<sha-prefix> symlink to outside folder; valid fictional www.congreso.es URL with fake local response and patched sleep; no internet or real originals.
risk_boundary: Requires ability to plant/replace a symlink in the local storage tree or another untrusted storage condition. No claim of remote exploitation, and there is currently no public HTTP ingest route. A trusted private root with restrictive permissions reduces exposure; concurrency and symlink race need careful design.
proposed_next_AB_discriminator: Preregister and run tests for pre-existing symlink directory, symlink leaf object, path swaps during write, concurrent same-hash writers and root permissions. Implement safe local object creation using directory identity/no-follow protections and atomic metadata only after integrity verification; re-run full tests and original-free fake data pipeline.
